content.short: Premium destination for sophisticated art collectors to purchase an interest in physical, high-value art pieces by fractionalized NFTs.
content.description:
Budja.io is an Innovative Startup that Tokenizes Art for ownership on the Blockchain: Non-fungible tokens (or NFTs) are unique blockchain-based tokens that can represent physical assets. Budja.io leverages On-Chain and Off-Chain application technology. The Non-Fungible Tokens created, which represent real world art assets, will be traded on Blockchain Assets AG Digital Asset Exchange

Active projects are four original Andy Warhol art works totaling $1.5M and 600 rare NASA photographs totaling $1.8M.
